sources.entry: KubeContext - import, manage and switch between your Kubernetes contexts on Mac.

summary.one_liner: KubeContext is a small macOS menu bar app for importing, managing, and switching between Kubernetes contexts.
summary.what_it_does: The app sits in the Mac menu bar and lets you switch the active Kubernetes context from there. It can import contexts from additional kubeconfig files and export them back out. A context management UI supports renaming contexts and setting their namespace. Contexts can be assigned colors, and the current context name is shown in the menu bar.
how_to_run: Install from the Mac App Store
Install with Homebrew: brew install --cask kubecontext
Download a build from the project's Releases page
notable: Lives in the macOS menu bar and shows the active context name there
Imports and exports contexts to and from kubeconfig files
Assign colors to contexts to tell clusters apart
Context management UI for renaming contexts and setting namespaces
caveats: The Mac App Store version has pro features as in-app purchases; other install options are described as fully unlocked and free
